project.name: Destiny OS :: Engine :: Phong Thuy (Bat Trach Kua)
project.description:
Bat Trach (Eight Mansions) Kua number and the eight Bat Bien Du Nien directions - research item R7, Phase 10.
The 8x8 direction table is DERIVED from the cited line-change rule (Bat Bien Du Nien / 游年 变爻), not transcribed cell by cell. A transcribed table can carry a typo no reader notices; a derived one is checkable against published tables, and that check is what caught four wrong cells in the only complete English-language table found.
The Kua year boundary (Lap Xuan vs Tet) is genuinely disputed between Vietnamese and classical practice and is NOT resolved here: the engine computes both and, when they disagree, reports both and emits no signal rather than choosing for the user.
Framework-free, like the other engines. Depends on destiny-calendar, which is infrastructure rather than an engine.
